raw_segments.text: Heaven and the immortal gods, he exclaimed, forbid that you should leave my house to go
Do you think I am so poor and short of clothes, or that I have so few cloaks, and as to be
unable to find comfortable beds both for myself and for my guests?
Let me tell you I have store both of rugs and cloaks, and shall not permit the son of
my old friend Ulysses to camp down on the deck of a ship, not while I live, nor yet
will my sons after me, but they will keep open house as I have done.
